question: Will the talks restart in November, yes or no?

lines.text: Vladimir Putin has agreed in principle to restart three way talks with Ukraine and the US.
The Kremlin says he told US envoy Steve Witkoff after three hours in St Petersburg.
Putin's adviser Yuri Ushakov says talks could resume around 10 November, possibly in Abu Dhabi.
The focus, he says, is building a security system for Russia and Ukraine after the conflict ends.

scene.quote: Building a security system for Russia and Ukraine after the conflict ends

lines.text: Before the meeting, Russia freed American Stephen Hubbard, a 74 year old retired teacher.
He was held more than four years after Russian troops seized him in eastern Ukraine.
Putin announced it himself: he is at Pulkovo Airport.
Donald Trump says no swap was needed for the release.
Witkoff called Putin a humanitarian. Two Republican senators objected.
A US official says Ukraine accepted the format in Oslo on Tuesday.
Zelensky says a freeze is the minimum needed to end this war.

scene.quote: Right now, we have to freeze

lines.text: But Ushakov says the Oslo talks did not contain much of use.

scene.quote: The Oslo talks didn't contain much that was useful
